walkthroughs.body_html:
Operations Management — a core area of GCSE Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Operations Management brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Operations Management.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why might a business adopt corporate social responsibility (CSR)?
options: Reasons include genuine ethics, but also commercial benefits — improved reputation, customer loyalty, employee retention, and reduced regulatory or reputational risk.
CSR is purely about being ethical with no business benefit.
